sync_clock.name: Synchronize Stove Clock
sync_clock.description: Synchronize stove time and date with the current Home Assistant time and date.

set_chrono_program.name: Set chrono program
set_chrono_program.description: Program one of the weekly chrono programs of the stove/boiler in a single request. Only the fields you fill in are changed. The days you select are enabled, all the others are disabled. Times are rounded down to 10 minutes.

start.name: Start time
start.description: Time the program switches the appliance on.

stop.name: Stop time
stop.description: Time the program switches the appliance off.

days.name: Days
days.description: Weekdays on which the program is active.

water_temperature.name: Water temperature
water_temperature.description: Water set temperature used by the program.

boiler_temperature.name: Boiler temperature
boiler_temperature.description: Boiler (DHW tank) set temperature used by the program.

acs.name: DHW
acs.description: Enable domestic hot water production during the program.

weekly_enabled.name: Weekly chrono enabled
weekly_enabled.description: Switch the weekly chrono function on or off for the whole device.

user.title: Micronova Agua IOT options
user.description: Select `Bluetooth (auto-detect)` to let Home Assistant auto-detect and validate a nearby Micronova BLE module when you submit the form (experimental).
